title: Operator ergodic theorems with Möbius "weights"
summary: Motivated by Sarnak's conjecture in topological dynamics for the Möbius function $μ$, we study, for a power-bounded $T$ on a Banach space $E$, the weak convergence $$ (*) \qquad \qquad \frac1N\sum_{n=1}^N μ(n)T^nv \to 0 \text{ weakly } \forall v\in E. $$ For that, we introduce a notion of dynamical entropy for operators, which we denote $h^*_{top}(T)$, and show that if Sarnak's conjecture is true, then $h^*_{top}(T)=0$ implies the desired convergence (*). We conclude an equivalent operator formulation of Sarnak's conjecture. For several classes of operators we prove that (*) holds, and that…
